svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1079 commits across five public projects, 77 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-07-25 through 2026-10-16 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-10-16T14:46:56.065Z.
